thread:
Anika K.: Quick heads-up — we need to recalibrate RICE for next quarter. New enterprise ask (low-latency SLA, dedicated) shifts impact and effort. Thoughts?
Derek L.: Saw the ask. Impact high but effort = infra + perf work. Hard to hit with current squad.
Priya S.: Can we sequence: small canary for top 3 customers, then broader rollout? reduces upfront effort.
Samir R.: Sequencing helps, but we also need to consider model routing + caching tradeoffs. If we enable per-route caching, perf wins with less infra change.
Jordan (eng): Agree w/ Samir. Per-route caching adds engineering but is lower risk than changing serving runtime.
Lee (sales): Customer will pay for SLA but wants launch within quarter. Can we promise canary within 8 weeks?
Anika K.: Proposal: reweight RICE to emphasize Impact (x1.5) for enterprise revenue deals. Also add sequencing multiplier for canary viability.
Priya S.: Quick RICE sketch:
```text
Feature                 R  I  C  E  Score
Predictive routing      5  8  3  2  60
Per-route caching       4  7  5  2  56
Autoscale-burst         3  4  6  1  12
```
(Don't trust numbers, just for convo)
Derek L.: If we boost Impact weight, predictive routing jumps. But cost (C) is higher than shown — needs infra estimate.
Samir R.: Suggest split: M1 = per-route caching + canary for 3 customers (MVP). M2 = predictive routing + autoscale enhancements.
Lee (sales): M1 acceptable to customers; they'd sign a short-term addendum for canary access.
Jordan (eng): Team capacity: M1 doable with 2 engs + 1 SRE for 6 weeks. M2 needs 4+ weeks after M1.
Anika K.: Decision check — reweight impact x1.5 and sequence M1 then M2. Approve?
Priya S.: +1
Derek L.: +1
Samir R.: +1
Lee (sales): +1 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New action created: #action-1234 track M1 canary plan — assigned to @Samir R.
Anika K.: I'll update the roadmap doc and send a short brief to sales/customer success with the canary timeline.
Lee (sales): Thanks. I'll draft the customer note once you share.
Anika K.: Filing note: revisit RICE weights at mid-quarter if we get more enterprise asks. Keeping the scoring transparent helped here.
